Ex: The local clubs are making every effort to interest more young people.

Ex: Sweden has a reputation for advanced and stylish design.

(adjective). Rõ ràng

(noun). sức sống mới

theory

(adjective). gần đây

(verb). thông báo

(noun). sự tiến bộ

(verb). nhận được

(adverb). đích thực, thực sự

shrink

(verb). Thu nhỏ, co lại, rút lại

Ex: The internet in a sense has shrunk the world.

as if

(adverb). như thể là

Ex: It's my birthday. As if you didn't know!

sampling

(noun). sự lấy mẫu

Ex: Something has gone wrong in the sampling methods used by the market researchers.

project

(verb). chiếu

Ex: The videos were projected onto two screens.

expose

(verb). phô bày

Ex: Miles of sand are exposed at low tide.

demonstrate

(verb). Trình bày, minh hoạ

Ex: New research convincingly demonstrates that age-related memory loss is not inevitable.

viewer

(noun). người xem

Ex: Her performance has grabbed the attention of 100 million YouTube viewers.

proportionately

(adverb). theo tỷ lệ, tương xứng

Ex: Prices have risen but wages have not risen proportionately.

various

(adjective). khác nhau, đa dạng

Ex: We talked about jobs, family, football and various other things.

surveillance

(noun). giám sát

Ex: The police are keeping the suspects under constant surveillance.

security

(noun). an ninh

Ex: They carried out security checks at the airport.

recognition

(noun). sự nhận ra

Ex: He glanced briefly towards her but there was no sign of recognition.

military

(noun). lực lượng quân sự

Ex:

field

(noun). lĩnh vực

Ex: Child development is such an interesting field.

application

(noun). ứng dụng

Ex: The design has many applications.

amateur

(noun). nghiệp dư

Ex: The tournament is open to both amateurs and professionals.

preserve

(verb). Bảo quản, giữ gìn

Ex: Efforts to preserve the peace have failed.

description

(noun). Sự miêu tả, sự mô tả

Ex: The name means ‘no trees’ and it is an accurate description of the island.

significant

(adjective). Đáng lưu ý, quan trọng

Ex: There are no significant differences between the two groups of students.

mainstay

(noun). trụ cột

Ex: He is the mainstay of our theatre group.

commonly

(adverb). thường, thông thường

Ex: These fats are commonly found in processed foods.

reference

(noun). sự nói đến, sự nhắc đến

Ex: She made no reference to her illness but only to her future plans.

worth

(adjective). đáng giá

Ex: If you answer this question correctly, it's worth five points.

wisdom

(noun). sự thông thái, lẽ phải thông thường

Ex: Native American wisdom was passed on from generation to generation.

repeatedly

(adverb). có tính lặp lại

Ex: He called repeatedly, begging her to come back.

prospect

(noun). Triển vọng, khả năng

Ex: There's a reasonable prospect that his debts will be paid.

assure

(verb). bảo đảm, quả quyết

Ex: We were assured that everything possible was being done.

aspect

(noun). Khía cạnh

Ex: The book aims to cover all aspects of city life.

release

(noun). sự phát hành

Ex: I hadn't seen the movie since its original release.

process

(verb). xử lí

Ex: My brain slowly processed the fact that I was free to leave.

convert

(verb). Chuyển đổi

Ex: The hotel is going to be converted into a nursing home.

unmanned

(adjective). không người vận hành

Ex: Both designs represent a new generation of unmanned aircraft, which began in the 1990s with robotic spy planes.

effort

(noun). sự cố gắng

Ex: The local clubs are making every effort to interest more young people.

device

(noun). thiết bị

Ex: The new devices will be installed at US airports.

advanced

(adjective). hiện đại, nâng cao

Ex: Sweden has a reputation for advanced and stylish design.
